title: Mixed Poisson diffusion models and application to posterior sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.20218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models are a powerful framework for learning complex probability distributions. While widely used diffusion models for continuous data rely on Gaussian noising processes, we instead develop diffusion models based on Poisson noise. More precisely, we introduce and study a new mathematical framework, called Mixed Poisson Diffusion Models (MPDM), with noising dynamics driven by multivariate counting processes.   Our methodology is motivated by Poisson inverse problems. The success of Gaussian diffusion models has led to their use as prior models in a growing number of posterior sampling methods for inverse problems. However, most of these approaches focus on Gaussian inverse problems, in which observations are generated through a deterministic forward operator corrupted by additive Gaussian noise. translated_title: 混合泊松扩散模型及其在后验采样中的应用
translated_abstract: 扩散模型是学习复杂概率分布的强大框架。虽然广泛使用的连续数据扩散模型依赖于高斯加噪过程，但我们转而开发了基于泊松噪声的扩散模型。更准确地说，我们引入并研究了一个新的数学框架，称为混合泊松扩散模型（Mixed Poisson Diffusion Models, MPDM），其加噪动力学由多元计数过程驱动。我们的方法受泊松逆问题的启发。高斯扩散模型的成功使其在越来越多的逆问题后验采样方法中被用作先验模型。然而，这些方法大多聚焦于高斯逆问题，即观测值通过确定性前向算子生成并被加性高斯噪声所污染。相比之下，观测值离散且服从泊松分布的泊松逆问题在此领域仍相对缺乏探索。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由多元计数过程驱动的混合泊松扩散模型（MPDM），为观测数据离散且服从泊松分布的泊松逆问题提供了后验采样的新框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mixed Poisson Diffusion Models (MPDM), a novel diffusion framework with noising dynamics driven by multivariate counting processes, enabling posterior sampling for Poisson inverse problems where observations are discrete and Poisson distributed.
